text: PART III - LANDS NOTICE CALLING FOR CLAIMS TO PROPERTY OF INTESTATE REGISTRATION OF TITLE ACT, NO. 21 OF 1998 (SECTION 55) Reference the intestate property of late Mr. Dikwella Gamage Asitha Prasad Dewa who resides in the village of Borupana, in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Moratuwa, in the District of Colombo.
